title: What reviewers call a Long Method is a length: A pre-registered test of coupling divergence as a god-unit signal, and what it settled instead
abstract: arXiv:2611.01636v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A companion study found that a complexity outlier rule shows where complexity concentrates but cannot tell a god unit from a complex algorithm. This paper pre-registered a test of one way to tell them apart: weight a unit's complexity by its coupling divergence, the data it hands on minus the data it receives, so that a leaf is set aside. Coupling was measured by resolving every call in 520 MLCQ repositories, 500 fresh Java repositories and 73 Qualitas Corpus systems. The claim fails: the primary, the pooled MCC of the weighted form minus complexity alone against MLCQ's human Blob, is -0.041 [-0.130, +0.054], no difference resolved and underpowered, and the resolved readings go against it. What the data settle is at method level. What MLCQ's reviewers call a Long Method is an absolute length: a constant of 26 lines or more, chosen on the explore half, reaches MCC 0.777 on the confirm half, +0.080 [+0.016, +0.145] over the best per-re

translated_title: 审阅者所称的长方法只是一种长度：一项将耦合散度作为上帝单元信号的预注册测试，以及它最终实际证实的内容
translated_abstract: 一项配套研究发现，复杂度离群值规则能够显示复杂度集中在何处，但无法区分上帝单元与复杂算法。本文预先注册了一项测试，以验证区分两者的方法之一：用耦合散度（即单元传出的数据减去接收的数据）对单元复杂度加权，从而将叶子单元排除在外。耦合度量的获得方式是解析520个MLCQ仓库、500个全新Java仓库以及73个Qualitas Corpus系统中的每一次调用。该主张未能成立：主要结果——加权形式减去仅用复杂度后，针对MLCQ中人类标注Blob类的合并MCC——为-0.041 [-0.130, +0.054]，差异未获解决且统计功效不足，而已解决的读数反而与该主张相悖。数据所能确定的是方法层面的：MLCQ审阅者所称的长方法是一种绝对长度——在探索半部分选定的26行或以上的常数阈值，在确认半部分达到MCC 0.777，比最佳的每仓库……高出+0.080 [+0.016, +0.145]。
tldr: 预注册测试表明，用耦合散度加权复杂度无法区分上帝单元与复杂算法；该研究真正证实的是，MLCQ审阅者所称的“长方法”仅仅是一个绝对行数长度（26行及以上的阈值在确认集上达到MCC 0.777）。
en_tdlr: A pre-registered test shows that weighting complexity by coupling divergence cannot distinguish god units from complex algorithms; instead, it establishes that what MLCQ reviewers call a Long Method is simply an absolute length, with a constant threshold of 26 lines or more reaching MCC 0.777 on the confirm split.
